name: Private menu mutation transport/request boundary
phase: Discovery and specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
architecturalPurpose: Define bounded framework-neutral private menu mutation submissions whose bodies are consumed only after fresh gate authorization and whose mutations independently reauthorize through the existing workspace/service. No endpoint or runtime activation is created.

startingState.head: ab40f63db9bd2c036c2b1703c979408b73433a2a
startingState.worktree: Verified clean before discovery and specification

discoveryFindings.operationCounts: FoodMenuRepository and FoodPrivateMenuService expose 23 operations: eight mutations and fifteen reads. FoodPrivateMenuWorkspaceController wraps those 23 and adds getOfferWorkspaceDetail, a read aggregate. Only the eight mutations belong in M.
discoveryFindings.gate: FoodPrivateMenuOperationGate.runAuthorized<T>(callback: () => T | Promise<T>): Promise<FoodMenuAuthorizedCallbackResult<T>> authorizes fresh without repository access; callback values remain opaque and callback errors are sanitized.
discoveryFindings.runtime: FOOD-002L supplies frozen FoodPrivateMenuOperationRuntimeCapabilities { service, workspace, operationGate }. service and operationGate are the same concrete instance and workspace wraps it. Existing narrow runtime factories remain intact.
discoveryFindings.domainValidation: menu-persistence validates supplied snapshots and loads exact dependencies during append. Workspace delegates without input prevalidation; service authorizes before repository access. M therefore needs no pre-dispatch domain validators or exact-read lookup operations.
discoveryFindings.precedent: FOOD-001J already uses a lazy AsyncIterable<Uint8Array> envelope, strict mandatory canonical Origin, POST, URL-form singleton JSON, bounded streaming and duplicate-aware JSON. Its helpers are module-private, not exported shared primitives. Reuse the design without modifying FOOD-001J or importing its four-operation transport as menu authority.
discoveryFindings.otherOriginPattern: insurance/http/quote-request-api.ts accepts missing Origin and compares normalized URL origins. That policy is weaker than FOOD-001J and is not suitable for this mandatory private-menu Origin boundary.
discoveryFindings.capacity: FOOD-002C permits 20 sections, 100 entries per section and 20 offer selections per entry: 2000 entries and 40000 selections. Each entry may select 20 media references. FOOD-002B media arrays and canonical IDs have no finite domain cardinality/length bound. FOOD-001J's 65536-byte/2048-value limits cannot describe the full menu topology; no finite transport can accommodate every domain-valid snapshot. M explicitly separates capacity rejection from domain invalidity.

api.inputDefinition: export interface FoodMenuMutationRequestBoundaryInput { readonly operationGate: FoodPrivateMenuOperationGate; readonly workspace: FoodPrivateMenuWorkspaceController; readonly expectedOrigin: string; }
api.boundaryDefinition: export interface FoodMenuMutationRequestBoundary { submit(envelope: FoodMenuMutationRequestEnvelope): Promise<FoodMenuMutationRequestResult>; }
api.dependencyPolicy: Inject only gate, workspace and trusted expectedOrigin. Do not accept the full runtime bundle, service, repository, database, environment, session, principal, administrator configuration or token. A later caller projects operationGate/workspace from the same L runtime.
api.construction: Synchronous, I/O-free, frozen submit-only output. Capture trusted dependencies without invoking any gate/workspace/service/resolver/body/database/FOOD-001/network operation. Do not access request metadata until submit. Invalid expectedOrigin rejects submissions as origin-rejected before gate/body; introduce no configuration failure vocabulary.

requestEnvelope.definition: export interface FoodMenuMutationRequestEnvelope { readonly method: string; readonly origin: string | null; readonly contentType: string | null; readonly contentLength?: string; readonly readBody: () => AsyncIterable<Uint8Array>; }
requestEnvelope.preAuthorizationAccess: Only method, origin, contentType and optional contentLength, plus the trusted expectedOrigin. Validate in that order. Do not inspect/access the readBody property, iterator or snapshot/operation fields before successful gate authorization. Throwing metadata access maps to invalid-request without gate/body work.

executionOrder: Validate metadata policy without accessing the body reader; any failure returns immediately with zero gate/body calls.
Call operationGate.runAuthorized with a zero-argument lazy callback. Never duplicate administrator checks or perform a dummy repository read/write.

Only inside the authorized callback access/invoke readBody, consume bounded bytes once, decode URL-form, parse bounded duplicate-aware JSON and validate the transport envelope/discriminator/numeric lexical representation.
Use an explicit switch over the eight allowed operation literals and invoke exactly one existing workspace mutation with parsed snapshot and, for revisions, the explicit predecessor.
That workspace mutation calls FOOD-002E and authorizes fresh a second time before repository validation, dependency lookup or write. No gate decision is inherited.

The gate treats the nested transport/workspace result as opaque. On outer gate success unwrap that value; on outer failure map only the allowed access/callback codes to fixed messages. Never mistake a nested expected failure for failed gate authorization.

requestPolicy.method: Exactly POST; all other spellings/methods return method-not-allowed before gate/body access.
requestPolicy.origin: Require one canonical serialized HTTP(S) origin exactly equal to trusted expectedOrigin. new URL(value).origin must equal the original string; do not normalize the input. Reject missing, literal null, opaque, multiple, wildcard, suffix-match, cross-origin, credential-bearing, path/query/fragment, noncanonical case/port and unsupported-scheme values. No Referer, Host or Forwarded fallback.
requestPolicy.contentType: Accept only application/x-www-form-urlencoded with optional single charset=UTF-8, quoted or unquoted. Media-type/charset tokens are case-insensitive; permit surrounding HTTP parameter whitespace as FOOD-001J does. Reject all other parameters, repeated charset, multipart, JSON bodies and other encodings. Do not add decompression.
requestPolicy.csrf: Preserve FOOD-001J scope: no extra CSRF token. This relies on mandatory exact Origin, POST-only handling and authenticated fresh authorization, not session authentication alone. A later route must supply a separately trusted expectedOrigin and preserve this policy; weakening it requires separate CSRF review. M acquires no production origin configuration.
requestPolicy.contentLength: If present, require string spelling 0 or [1-9][0-9]* representing a nonnegative safe integer. Missing is permitted; explicit null, whitespace, signs, leading zero, exponent, fraction, multiple/comma values or unsafe numbers are invalid-request. A valid value above encodedBodyBytes is payload-too-large before gate/body. Smaller or absent declarations never replace actual stream enforcement. Do not require equality with actual byte count, matching FOOD-001J.

wireFormat.operation: Exactly one decoded singleton string equal to one allowlisted existing method name. No aliases, case folding, fuzzy matching, prototype lookup or reflective method dispatch.
wireFormat.snapshot: Exactly one singleton string containing a complete structured JSON object of the existing operation's snapshot type. No repository serialization wrapper, indexed fields, nested form syntax, partial update, checkbox inference or parallel model.
wireFormat.predecessor: Initial operations forbid both predecessor fields. Presentation/offer/publication revisions require exactly expectedPreviousVersion and forbid expectedPreviousRevision. Availability revision requires exactly expectedPreviousRevision and forbids expectedPreviousVersion.
wireFormat.formParsing: Strict UTF-8 body and percent-field decoding with plus-to-space URL-form decoding. Reject invalid UTF-8, malformed percent escapes, malformed/empty segments, missing required fields, unexpected fields and repeated decoded field names, including escaped-equivalent names. Do not trim/normalize values. Files/multipart are unsupported. Syntax/field-shape failures are invalid-request.
wireFormat.jsonParsing: Use a bounded duplicate-aware parser/tokenizer, not JSON.parse alone or a reviver. Detect duplicate decoded keys at every object before insertion, including escaped equivalents. Reject __proto__, constructor and prototype at every level. Construct records without prototype setters. Reject malformed grammar, trailing content and non-object root as invalid-request. Preserve JSON array order, exact strings, omission and explicit null/unknown values; JSON grammar whitespace does not trim domain text.

limits.counting: Inclusive limits. Root container depth is 1. Count every object, array and scalar once; decoded property names count toward string limits but not value count. Bound both decoded property names and values. Count body bytes before decoding and decoded snapshot bytes as UTF-8. Every capacity violation maps to payload-too-large, never domain invalid-input.
limits.rationale: 32 MiB encoded / 24 MiB decoded capacity avoids the 64 KiB draft-transport ceiling. Maximum publication topology with full media selection contains approximately 458000 JSON values, below 1000000; deepest publication container is depth 8, below 12; all domain-bounded individual arrays are at most 100. 40000 transport array entries also allows substantially larger unbounded presentation media arrays without asserting a new domain limit. IDs and presentation media cardinality remain unbounded in the domain. Large IDs, maximally long/media-rich publications or large form percent-encoding expansion can still exceed finite byte/string/node/array capacity. Such domain-valid snapshots receive payload-too-large and remain valid for other typed domain callers; never silently truncate, split, prune or reinterpret them as invalid-input. These are transport resource limits, not domain changes or a guarantee that every legal maximal snapshot fits.
limits.memory: Enforce bounds before unbounded allocation/recursive descent. Stop copying once stream overflow is known; reject arrays/nodes/depth/decoded strings as soon as limits are exceeded. Bound transport memory independently of declared length.

streaming: Access and invoke readBody at most once, inside authorized callback only. Obtain one async iterator and accept only Uint8Array chunks; copy accepted chunks to prevent caller mutation.
Reader/iterator construction or next() failure returns fixed body-unavailable. A non-byte chunk or malformed iterator result returns invalid-request. No raw getter/iterator exception leaks.

Count actual streamed bytes independently of Content-Length. On overflow return payload-too-large immediately, stop pulling/draining, and call iterator.return where available. Cleanup failure cannot replace the original typed failure.

Never retry consumption, parsing or dispatch. Unauthorized submissions access the reader zero times and consume zero bytes. Separate concurrent submissions retain only per-invocation parse/authorization state.

payloadMapping.presentation: Full existing FoodDishPresentation: dishId, version, product { id, version }, recipe { id, version }, name and optional shortDescription/longDescription/mediaReferences [{ reference }]. Exact FOOD-001 references are supplied unchanged; M performs no FOOD-001 lookup.
payloadMapping.offer: Full existing FoodServingOffer: offerId, version, presentation { dishId, version }, format, servingEstimate and optional packagingDescription/storageSummary/reheatingSummary. Preserve individual/family/catering/custom, catering pan details, explicit unknown/specification and omitted descriptor differences.
payloadMapping.publication: Full existing FoodMenuPublication: publicationId, version, state, title, ordered sections [{ key, title, entries [{ presentation { dishId, version }, selection { shortDescription, longDescription, mediaReferences }, offers [{ offer { offerId, version }, intent, selection { packagingDescription, storageSummary, reheatingSummary, availability } }] }] }]. Preserve exact references, all booleans and section/entry/offer/media order. No automatic selection or public projection.
payloadMapping.availability: Full existing FoodServingOfferAvailability: offer { offerId, version }, revision, state. Observation revision is independent from offer version; never retarget to current/latest offer.
payloadMapping.numerics: Every JSON property named version or revision must contain an unquoted [1-9][0-9]* numeric token that converts exactly to a positive safe integer. Apply the same lexical/representation rule to servingEstimate minimum/maximum. Reject numeric strings, zero, negative/sign forms, fractions, exponents and unsafe integers as invalid-request; do not round/coerce. Form predecessor uses the same canonical positive decimal spelling within 16 digits and converts exactly. Domain validators retain authority over positive/range/consecutive/current-predecessor semantics; no generated version or inferred relation.
payloadMapping.domainBoundary: M validates transport object-root/fields/duplicate safety/numeric lexical representation only. Forward nested content unchanged to the typed workspace operation; a localized untrusted-input type assertion may bridge parsed unknown to the existing parameter type but does not certify domain validity or grant authority. Do not construct a parallel domain abstraction or call domain validators before dispatch. Repository uses existing FOOD-002B/C validators and exact contexts after second authorization. Unknown/extra nested domain fields, noncanonical IDs, enums, disallowed nulls, missing domain fields, range errors and dangling references remain repository/service invalid-input or storage according to existing contracts. Extra outer form fields are transport invalid-request. Never normalize IDs, text, enums or references, fill defaults, merge omitted fields, substitute latest or add fields.

doubleAuthorization.first: Gate authorization permits only this one callback/body continuation; it performs no repository access and issues no permission token.
doubleAuthorization.second: The selected workspace mutation always invokes normal FOOD-002E fresh authorization before any input use/validation or repository call. Transport must not bypass it through a direct repository/service implementation reference.
doubleAuthorization.sessionChange: After first success the body may have been read, but a changed/missing/revoked/unavailable caller on the second check prevents persistence and returns the normal fixed workspace access failure. No atomic request/session guarantee or inherited/cached authorization.
doubleAuthorization.unsupported: All fifteen service reads, getOfferWorkspaceDetail and arbitrary member names are invalid-request. M performs no helper read or aggregate; exact dependency resolution stays in the authorized repository append.

results.definition: Union of Awaited<ReturnType<FoodPrivateMenuWorkspaceController['createInitialPresentation']>>, the equivalent createInitialOffer/createInitialPublication/createInitialAvailability results, and Readonly<{ ok: false; error: Readonly<{ code: FoodMenuMutationTransportErrorCode | 'callback-failed' | FoodMenuServiceErrorCode; message: string }> }>. Revisions use their corresponding identical snapshot result family. Export FoodMenuMutationTransportErrorCode as exactly the six transport-code literals below.

transportMessages.method-not-allowed: Private food menu mutations require POST.
transportMessages.origin-rejected: Private food menu request origin is not permitted.
transportMessages.unsupported-content-type: Private food menu request content type is not supported.
transportMessages.payload-too-large: Private food menu request exceeds the permitted limits.
transportMessages.invalid-request: The private food menu request is invalid.
transportMessages.body-unavailable: Private food menu request body could not be read.

results.gateAccess: Preserve unauthenticated, forbidden and access-unavailable distinctly; replace gate-supplied message text with existing FOOD_MENU_WORKSPACE_FEEDBACK for that code.
results.callbackFailure: Preserve callback-failed distinctly with exactly Private food menu operation could not be completed. Expected parsing/capacity/body failures return typed nested failures inside the callback; unexpected callback throw/rejection is left to K's callback-failed sanitation. Unexpected gate throw/rejection or malformed outer gate envelope also fails closed as this fixed callback-failed, without a new error code.
results.workspaceFailures: Preserve all five FOOD-002E/F codes distinctly with FOOD_MENU_WORKSPACE_FEEDBACK fixed messages: unauthenticated, forbidden, access-unavailable, invalid-input, storage. Do not preserve injected private error messages; malformed workspace mutation envelopes become fixed workspace storage.
results.mutationSuccess: Preserve created, already-present and conflict as distinct successful workspace values. Created/retry include only the successful detached frozen snapshot and existing fixed feedback; conflict has only outcome and fixed feedback, no reason or submitted snapshot. Preserve existing publicationLabel exactly; published remains a snapshot label, not activation.
results.notFound: No mutation result has found/not-found. A not-found injected mutation envelope is malformed and becomes storage, not a new successful empty/read result. Existing missing dependencies retain the repository's invalid-input/storage classification through the workspace.
results.shape: Use the existing ok/value or ok/error envelopes, not HTTP Response/status/redirect/cookie artifacts. All returned envelopes and successful snapshots are detached/deeply frozen; failed results contain only fixed code/message, never submitted payloads or evidence. No raw SQL/JSON/exception/stack/internal reason is retained.

retryAndPrivacy: No additional persisted idempotency key/submission token, automatic retry or version generation. Preserve FOOD-002D/G canonical same identity/version/content retry as already-present and differing content as conflict, including historical retry after later versions.

An uncertain caller retry must preserve exact operation, snapshot identity/version/revision/content/references and expected predecessor; never silently renumber, merge, retarget or repair. Storage failure makes no success claim.

No logging, telemetry or retained request state for raw/decoded body, private evidence, cookies, principals/admin IDs, environment, DB identifiers, secrets or errors. Successful private mutation snapshots are intentional existing workspace values; failed feedback never echoes submissions.
No delete/overwrite/public activation/order/payment/sale authority operation. Publication and availability remain independent descriptive records, with no readiness or orderability inference.

futureIntegration.runtime: A later trusted server caller obtains createPrivateFoodMenuOperationRuntimeFromServerContext success, projects { operationGate: runtime.operationGate, workspace: runtime.workspace }, and supplies independently trusted expectedOrigin to the M factory. Do not modify L or construct another authorization graph.
futureIntegration.request: A later route adapts actual metadata and one lazy bounded byte iterator to FoodMenuMutationRequestEnvelope. M itself acquires no headers/environment/origin/session configuration and creates no route or response.
futureIntegration.nextSlice: FOOD-002M implementation and validation only; route/server-request adaptation remains a separately specified later slice.

tests: Frozen construction performs zero gate/auth/body/workspace/FOOD-001/DB/network calls; output exposes submit only and no injected internals.

Policy matrix: all non-POST methods, malformed/missing/cross/multiple/opaque/noncanonical origins, invalid media types/parameters and malformed/oversized Content-Length reject before gate/reader access. Throwing reader getter proves pre-auth isolation.

Unauthenticated, forbidden, access-unavailable and malformed principal through actual K invoke callback/reader/parser zero times. Keep resolver outcomes fresh and separate concurrent out-of-order requests without authorization-state sharing.

Successful authorization permits exactly one lazy reader; actual limits override absent/underreported length. Verify exact inclusive byte boundary, overflow cleanup, cleanup exceptions, invalid chunks/iterator envelopes, reader/next exceptions and no reread/drain/retry.

Strict form UTF-8/percent/plus semantics, escaped repeated names, missing/unexpected/empty fields, wrong predecessor field and extra form fields all fail deterministically without evidence/message leakage.

JSON malformed/trailing/non-object, nested decoded duplicate/escaped-equivalent keys and every prototype-sensitive key fail closed. Verify depth/string/array/node/decoded-byte boundary counting including multibyte/surrogate text, ordered arrays and omitted versus null/unknown values.

Numeric matrix for root/nested versions, availability revision, serving bounds and predecessors: canonical positive safe integers accepted; strings, signs, zero, fractions, exponents, leading zeros and overflow rejected with no coercion. Domain range/sequencing validation remains downstream.

Exercise all eight literal operations and exact snapshot/predecessor/reference forwarding. Reject every read/history/list/aggregate, constructor/prototype/member name and unknown alias without reflective dispatch. No helper read or transport domain validation occurs.

Use real SingleAdminFoodMenuService plus workspace with isolated in-memory repository/fakes to prove two distinct fresh resolutions for valid mutations and revocation/unavailable second authorization after body read causes zero persistence calls. No configured D1 is used.

Exercise all four snapshot families, unknown descriptors, exact historical references, ordered publication membership and independent exact-offer availability streams. Invalid nested domain shape/extra fields/dangling references retain existing invalid-input/storage authority.

Test a large domain-valid publication exceeding FOOD-001J's old byte/node limits, and maximum 20x100x20 topology within selected byte/string capacity. A domain-valid snapshot exceeding M capacity is payload-too-large rather than invalid-input; never truncate or change domain limits.

Preserve created/already-present/conflict, historical identical retry, conflicting retry, full-replacement revisions and all five fixed workspace errors. Failure contains no submitted snapshot; conflict strips reason; malformed mutation result/not-found maps to storage.

Expected nested transport failure remains opaque gate success and unwraps correctly; unexpected callback throw/rejection and malformed/throwing gate map to fixed callback-failed without leaked parser/SQL/stack/body text.

Success and failure outputs are deterministic/frozen/detached. No automatic retry/version inference, mutable authorization state, arbitrary method dispatch, readiness inference or runtime/configured DB access.

Source isolation excludes Astro/Request/Response/FormData/routes/UI/environment acquisition/runtime wiring/administrator sourcing/migration/configuration/commerce/payment/deployment and unrelated subsystems. Existing K/L/workspace/service/repository contracts remain unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria: Only this specification is created and nothing is staged; initial branch/HEAD/clean gates pass.
Referenced existing types/functions/files and all eight workspace/service mutation names are verified against current code.
Implementation can satisfy metadata-before-gate, authorization-before-body and independent mutation authorization without changing existing authorities or activating infrastructure.
Wire/duplicate/numeric/resource/result rules are explicit and no domain-valid oversized input is silently reclassified as domain invalidity.
JSON parsing/reference/whitespace checks and git diff --check pass; no tracked file changes or database/body/config access occurs.
remainingAmbiguities: None requiring a shared-contract correction. Finite transport capacity intentionally excludes some unbounded domain-valid content as payload-too-large; later route adaptation and trusted origin configuration remain deferred, not prerequisites for M implementation.
